item.case_name: Poster or flyer with exact details

expect.asks_about: The date of the pottery workshop.

item.title: Workshop Flyer Missing Its Date

turns.text: Make a portrait 4:5 flyer for our Pottery Workshop at Clay House Studio, 14:00–16:00. It needs the event date on it too. Add 'Beginners welcome'. Soft earthy colours and a simple drawing of a clay bowl, please. No other wording.

item.tests: Checks that the agent asks for the missing event date rather than guessing, omitting it or leaving a placeholder; the completed flyer is graded after the supplied answer.

answer_sheet.Exact final wording: Pottery Workshop; 24 July 2027; 14:00–16:00; Clay House Studio; Beginners welcome. No other wording.
answer_sheet.Style and mood: Soft earthy colours with a simple drawing of a clay bowl; calm and welcoming.
answer_sheet.Size or platform: One portrait 4:5 digital flyer; no particular platform.

must_haves: The completed flyer shows the user-confirmed date exactly as '24 July 2027', not a guessed date or placeholder.
The time and venue read exactly '14:00–16:00' and 'Clay House Studio'.
The flyer includes exactly 'Beginners welcome' and no additional wording.
The portrait 4:5 design uses soft earthy colours and a simple clay bowl illustration.
All event details are legible and uncropped.

approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: Design a beautiful clean pottery workshop flyer, editorial graphic design with warm ivory background, terracotta clay tones, subtle paper grain, a simple elegant illustration of a handmade ceramic bowl and curved clay shapes near the bottom. Centered clear beautifully typeset typography, generous whitespace, strong hierarchy. Include ONLY these five exact text strings, each once, no other text or lettering: “Pottery Workshop”, “24 July 2027”, “14:00–16:00”, “Clay House Studio”, “Beginners welcome”. Main title large dark warm brown serif, other information legible refined typography. Keep all text and artwork within the central 80% width so the design can be reformatted to portrait 4:5. No logos, no watermarks, no extra words.
